executionPolicy.antiLoopRule: Reject work unless it verifies a missing exit criterion, removes a named completion blocker, or safely advances beyond a deferred true human gate.
executionPolicy.waveSuccessRule: A wave is productive only if it verifies an exit criterion, clears a gate, integrates an exact-SHA candidate, emits a receipt, closes a macrocycle, or advances the execution cursor past a true human gate.
executionPolicy.blockedProjectRule: A true human gate blocks only its exact sensitive action and strictly dependent work; it is persisted to pendingHumanGates and never stops the project scheduler or other enabled projects.
executionPolicy.fanOutRule: Dispatch closure work independently for every enabled project and continue safe work even when one or more human gates are pending.

completed.title: Modalità rapide, casa, viaggio e attrezzatura

active.title: Privacy, autorizzazioni e protezione dati
active.outcome: Personal and image data have enforced lifecycle and access controls.

exitCriteria.description: Authenticated authorization boundaries are enforced for personal, training, wearable and image records; cross-user or stale-session access fails closed across read and mutation paths.
Consent, retention, withdrawal and deletion lifecycle state is durable, attributable and deterministic, including dependent or derived records without silent orphaning.
Sensitive image and physical evidence is minimized and protected across upload, read, export and deletion, with no browser-local, query or direct-object bypass of authorization.
Product CI, independent review, realistic privacy/authorization Robot journey, exact-SHA integration and post-merge replay all pass and a completion receipt is persisted.

Catalogo prodotti, MINSAN, EAN e ricerca universale

active.title: Documenti, fatturazione e numerazioni
active.outcome: Operational documents are generated, stored and validated consistently.

exitCriteria.description: Canonical durable document and invoice records bind customer, sale or service origin, fiscal totals, operator and document type to validated persistent identities before issuance.
Document series and numbering are deterministic, collision-safe and exactly-once under retry and concurrency, with gaps or conflicts explicitly attributable rather than silently reused.
Issued documents remain immutable or explicitly versioned; corrections, credit notes and replacements link to the original and fail closed on invalid totals, origin or lifecycle state.
The operator journey can create, reopen, search and export documents with explicit draft/issued/corrected/exception states and no hidden fiscal mutation.
Product CI, independent review, PFarma document/invoice Robot plus required cumulative simulation, exact-SHA integration and post-merge replay all pass and a completion receipt is persisted.

completed.title: Ricerca, filtri, duplicati e qualità archivio

active.title: Conflitti, idempotenza e consistenza distribuita
active.outcome: Concurrent changes reconcile deterministically and safely.

exitCriteria.description: Distributed media, metadata and organization mutations retain durable causal/version identity and conflicting concurrent changes produce explicit family-scoped conflict records.
Retry and conflict resolution are deterministic and idempotent, preserve canonical provenance and never silently overwrite, duplicate or orphan valid media or metadata.
Concurrent edits, interrupted reconciliation and partition-like replay resume from durable checkpoints and fail closed on causal ambiguity, corruption or unauthorized resolution.
Conflict, lag and reconciliation health are explicitly visible to authorized family members without leaking inaccessible object or member metadata.
Product CI, independent review, realistic multi-node conflict/reconciliation Robot journey, exact-SHA integration and post-merge replay all pass and a completion receipt is persisted.

transitionRule: Certified completion activates the next macrocycle immediately. A true human gate keeps its macrocycle OPEN as DEFERRED_HUMAN_GATE in pendingHumanGates but also advances the execution cursor so autonomous independent work never stops.
reconciliationRule: Before every wave, replace stale PR, SHA, integration, completion and human-gate fields using live GitHub evidence and commit ancestry; revisit pending human gates on every trigger.
